name: cycles-correspondence-vectors
rule: With an envelope supplied, a permit receipt must cite a reserve envelope and a release receipt a release envelope, each naming the receipt's own reservation_id. Only stage and reservation are compared. Denials are not checked. The hash and envelope signature checks run first.

cases.description: Permit citing the reserve envelope of its own reservation.

scope_of_claim.asserts: aps:cycles.permit:emit — a budget reservation was authorized on the Cycles rail under the named delegation; reservation_id anchors the rail-side outcome and cycles_evidence binds to the signed CyclesEvidence envelope.
does_not_assert: the reservation was committed
the action governed by the reservation completed
live ledger state at any time after issuance

denial_detail.message: Insufficient remaining budget for scope tenant=acme

scope_of_claim.asserts: aps:cycles.deny:emit — a Cycles budget-authority operation was refused with a closed-taxonomy Tier-1 denial reason; cycles.denial_detail preserves the canonical Cycles-side code Tier-2.

the agent acted maliciously
the underlying delegation is invalid (denial may flag a single missing constraint)
